temporal_compression.verdict: PASS on the environment; tie on single-cell frame streams
temporal_compression.evidence: env-16x16x2-T64: scp4d events cover 11.18% of element-frames vs 37.97% nonzero deltas; 4.40× smaller than delta. Frame fixtures: within ±25% of delta.

computational_efficiency.verdict: MIXED (estimate): fewer bytes and fewer downstream updates, more per-element decode work
computational_efficiency.evidence: env-16x16x2-T64: downstream dirty fraction scp4d 27.23% vs full_q 38.57% vs tensor 77.39%; but at T=256 the rank-2 base changes every element each frame (dirty 80.91%). Decode estimate 45.8281–45.8623 pJ/element-frame vs delta 34.0784–34.229 and full_q 3.95707–4.12827 (model estimates). Software decode latency is also slower than delta on single-cell streams (stdout).
